content.text:
## Services architecture

### 1. Routes (`src/app`)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/app/(marketing)/[slug]/page.tsx` | **Only** service route. Shared with blog + case studies. |
| No `/services/` index page | “View all services” → `/full-service-amazon-agency/` |

**Pattern:** `/{slug}/` (root-level, trailing slash)

**Resolve order:** `getService(slug)` → `getCaseStudy(slug)` → `getBlogPost(slug)` → `notFound()`

**SSG:** `generateStaticParams` unions blog + service + case-study slugs; `dynamicParams = false`

---

### 2. Content config (JSON only — no service MDX)

`content/config/services/{slug}.json` — **15 files**, slug = filename:

| Slug / URL |
|------------|
| `/full-service-amazon-agency/` |
| `/amazon-ppc-management-agency/` |
| `/amazon-dsp-management/` |
| `/amazon-reporting-analytics/` |
| `/amazon-listing-optimization/` |
| `/amazon-content-writing/` |
| `/amazon-visual-creativity/` |
| `/amazon-video-creative/` |
| `/amazon-catalog-management/` |
| `/amazon-trademark-brand-registry/` |
| `/amazon-company-registration/` |
| `/amazon-product-sourcing/` |
| `/shopify-website-development/` |
| `/tiktok-shop-ads/` |
| `/email-retention-marketing/` |

---

### 3. Domain schema

`src/domain/content/schemas/service-page.schema.ts` → `ServicePageConfig`

| Field | Shape |
|-------|--------|
| `slug`, `breadcrumbLabel` | string |
| `hero` | `{ title, subtitle, cta: { label, href } }` |
| `stats[]` | `{ label, value }` |
| `problem` | `{ heading, points[{ title, description }] }` |
| `solution` | `{ heading, steps[{ title, description }] }` |
| `deliverables` | `{ heading, items[{ title, description }] }` |
| `results` | `{ heading, items[{ metric, brand, description, href }] }` |
| `faq[]` | faq schema |
| `relatedServices[]` | `{ title, description, href, icon? }` |
| `cta` | `{ heading, subheading?, button }` |
| `seo` | `pageSeoSchema`: `metaTitle`, `metaDescription`, `canonical`, `ogImage?`, `robots?`, `schema?` (`Article` \| `Service` \| …) |

Interface: `src/domain/content/content-repository.ts` — `getService`, `getAllServiceSlugs`

---

### 4. Templates / components / SEO

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/components/services/service-page-template.tsx` | Full page: breadcrumb, hero, stats, problem, solution, deliverables, results, FAQ, related services, CTA |
| `src/components/services/service-breadcrumb.tsx` | Breadcrumb |
| `src/components/sections/services-section.tsx` | Homepage (and related) card grid |
| `src/lib/seo/service-page-json-ld.ts` | `Service` + optional `FAQPage` JSON-LD |

---

### 5. How content loads

```
getContentRepository()
  → CompositeContentRepository
  → JsonFileContentRepository.getService(slug)
      reads content/config/services/{slug}.json
      validates with servicePageConfigSchema (Zod)
```

`getAllServiceSlugs()` = readdir of `content/config/services/*.json`.

---

### 6. Homepage services links

From `content/config/homepage.json` (`type: "services"`):

| Title | href |
|-------|------|
| Amazon Account Management | `/full-service-amazon-agency/` |
| PPC Management | `/amazon-ppc-management-agency/` |
| Listing Optimization and SEO | `/amazon-listing-optimization/` |
| Content Writing | `/amazon-content-writing/` |
| Visual Creativity | `/amazon-visual-creativity/` |
| Catalog Management | `/amazon-catalog-management/` |

**Nav mega menu** (`content/config/navigation.json`) links all **15** service URLs above.

---

### 7. Documented URLs

| Doc | Status |
|-----|--------|
| `docs/seo/URL-INVENTORY.md` § Service pages | **Empty** (“to be populated”) |
| `docs/seo/SITE-SEO-MAP.md` | Lists PPC + full-service; other services marked “Not started” (**stale** — JSON pages exist) |
| `docs/qa/VERIFICATION-LOG.md` | Confirms several service URLs HTTP 200 |

---

### Exist vs missing

| Status | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Exist** | All 15 nav/homepage-linked service JSON pages + shared `[slug]` route + template |
| **Missing** | Dedicated `/services/` index; service MDX; populated URL-INVENTORY service table |
| **Stale docs** | SITE-SEO-MAP still says many services “Not started” |
| **Homepage gap** | Only 6 of 15 services surfaced on homepage (by design) |
